supportPage.registrationGuide.title: How to Register and Activate Level 1
supportPage.registrationGuide.intro: This guide is for participants who have already set up and funded their wallet with the required assets.
supportPage.registrationGuide.summary: This article provides a step-by-step guide on how to register and activate Level 1 of the Fin Freedom Network program using both mobile and desktop devices. Key steps include connecting your wallet, accessing the activation page, activating Level 1, confirming the transaction, and adjusting gas fees if necessary. It also includes important reminders about security and ensuring sufficient funds.
supportPage.registrationGuide.mobile.ite: Connect Your Wallet
Open the official Fin Freedom Network website on your mobile browser.
Tap the Account Icon at the top-right corner of the screen.
Select Connect and follow the prompt to connect your wallet.
Open the Activation Page
After your wallet is connected, tap the Menu Icon at the top-right corner.
Go to Services.
Then tap Activation & Level Manager.
This will take you to the activation page.
Activate Level 1
On the activation page, click Activate Level 1.
If required, enter or paste your referrer ID or wallet address.
Then click Register & Activate Level 1.
Your wallet will open and ask you to approve the transaction.
Confirm the Transaction
When your wallet opens, review the transaction details carefully.
If everything is correct, tap Confirm to sign and submit the transaction.
Do not close the page while the transaction is processing.
If You See a Gas Limit or Network Fee Error
If you see an error such as "Transaction failed: Gas limit error", open the transaction fee settings in your wallet.
Tap the small pen/edit icon beside Network Fee.
Select Advanced.
Increase the Base Fee and Priority Fee to around 30 or above, then retry the transaction.
Confirm Your Activation
After the transaction is successful, return to the Activation & Level Manager page.
Refresh the page if necessary.
supportPage.registrationGuide.desktop.it: Connect Your Wallet
Open the official Fin Freedom Network website on your laptop or desktop browser.
Click the Account Icon at the top-right corner of the screen.
From the menu, select Connect and follow the steps to connect your wallet.
Open the Activation Page
After your wallet is connected, go to the top menu and click Services.
From the dropdown menu, select F-Freedom Program.
Then click Activation & Level Manager.
Activate Level 1
If required, paste your referrer ID or wallet address.
Your wallet panel will open for you to approve the transaction.
Confirm the Transaction
When the wallet panel opens, review the transaction details.
If everything is correct, click Confirm to sign and submit the transaction.
Wait for the transaction to complete successfully.
If You See a Gas Limit or Network Fee Error
If you encounter an error such as "Transaction failed: Gas limit error", click the small pen/edit icon beside Network Fee in your wallet.
Select Advanced.
Increase the Base Fee and Priority Fee to around 30 or above.
Then retry the transaction.
Confirm Your Activation
Return to the Activation & Level Manager page.
Refresh the page if needed.
Your account should now show that Level 1 has been successfully activated.
Make sure your wallet is connected to the correct network.
Make sure you have enough funds for activation and transaction fees.
Never share your Secret Recovery Phrase with anyone.
Fin Freedom Network will never ask for your Secret Recovery Phrase.
supportPage.glossary.items.0.definition: A decentralized and distributed ledger that records transactions in a transparent, immutable, and verifiable way. It allows smart contracts and automated systems to operate without centralized control, and all transactions can be publicly verified on-chain.
supportPage.glossary.items.1.definition: A program stored on the blockchain that automatically executes predefined actions when specific conditions are met. Smart contracts manage registrations, placements, payouts, upgrades, and recycling without human intervention, and all operations are transparent and verifiable on-chain.
supportPage.glossary.items.2.definition: A digital wallet used to interact with the blockchain. It works like a digital identity in the crypto world and allows users to access their positions, sign transactions, and interact with smart contracts. The wallet gives the user full control over their assets and positions. The responsibility for the funds and access to the wallet belongs entirely to the owner. If the private key or seed phrase is lost, the wallet and its contents cannot be recovered.
supportPage.glossary.items.3.definition: An operation recorded on the blockchain, such as a level activation, payout, upgrade, recycle, or token generation.
supportPage.glossary.items.4.definition: Operations that occur directly on the blockchain and can be publicly verified by anyone.
supportPage.glossary.items.5.definition: Data recorded on the blockchain that cannot be modified or deleted once confirmed.
supportPage.glossary.items.6.definition: A system that operates without a single central authority and is managed through distributed infrastructure and smart contracts.
supportPage.glossary.items.7.definition: A participation stage in the F-Freedom Program with a fixed price and defined structure. Participants progress level by level.
supportPage.glossary.items.8.definition: The process of purchasing and opening a level in the system.
supportPage.glossary.items.9.definition: Structure models that define position placement, payouts, recycling, and auto-upgrades within the F-Freedom Program.
supportPage.glossary.items.10.definition: The network positions connected to a participant within the orbit system.
supportPage.glossary.items.11.definition: The process from entering a level, completing the structure, receiving payouts, and recycling into a new cycle.
supportPage.glossary.items.12.definition: Automatic activation of the next level using part of the earnings generated in the current level.
supportPage.glossary.items.13.definition: When a level structure completes, the participant automatically repurchases the same level from their upline, receives a new empty level, and starts a new cycle.
supportPage.glossary.items.14.definition: A percentage deducted from payouts and allocated to ecosystem pools, NFT pools, and system development.
supportPage.glossary.items.15.definition: A pool funded by system charges and connected to NFT-related ecosystem benefits and distributions.
supportPage.glossary.items.16.definition: A unique digital asset stored on the blockchain that may provide access to ecosystem benefits, rewards, or participation mechanisms.
supportPage.glossary.items.17.definition: A functional ecosystem token generated when activating new levels. FGT cannot be bought or sold and can only be earned through participation and progression in the F-Freedom Program. FGT is connected to NFT qualification and ecosystem participation.
supportPage.glossary.items.18.definition: A functional ecosystem token generated when a level recycles. FGTr cannot be bought or sold and can only be earned through participation and recycling activity. FGTr is connected to long-term participation within the ecosystem.
supportPage.glossary.items.19.definition: A system where rewards are generated from activity, structure completion, and network participation rather than from investments or fixed returns.
supportPage.glossary.items.20.definition: A governance system where decisions related to the ecosystem may be made through community voting using tokens.
supportPage.glossary.items.21.definition: Moving from one level to the next level in the system.
supportPage.glossary.items.22.definition: The broader Fin Freedom Network that include multiple programs, tokens, NFTs, education platforms, governance systems, and future products developed by the community.
supportPage.glossary.items.23.definition: The participant who directly introduces a new participant into the system.
supportPage.glossary.items.24.definition: The participant positioned above another participant in the structure who receives positions or benefits from the activity of their downline.
supportPage.glossary.items.25.definition: The participants positioned below a participant in the structure.
supportPage.glossary.items.26.definition: The position assigned within an orbit structure when a new participant enters or when a recycle occurs.
supportPage.glossary.items.27.definition: A place inside an orbit structure that can generate payouts when filled according to the system rules.
supportPage.glossary.items.28.definition: A distribution automatically executed by the smart contract when a position or structure condition is completed.
supportPage.glossary.items.29.definition: A fund collected through system charges and allocated for specific ecosystem purposes such as NFT pools or development.
supportPage.glossary.items.30.definition: The conditions required to access certain benefits such as NFTs, pools, or ecosystem features.
supportPage.glossary.items.31.definition: A token that has a functional use inside a platform or ecosystem and is not designed for trading or speculation.
supportPage.glossary.items.32.definition: A system where users have full control over their wallet and assets without relying on a centralized entity.
supportPage.glossary.items.33.definition: The cryptographic keys that give full access to a wallet. Whoever controls the private key controls the wallet and its assets.
supportPage.glossary.items.34.definition: An application that runs on the blockchain and interacts with smart contracts instead of centralized servers.

securityPage.connect.description: Connect your wallet to review security best practices and understand your responsibilities.
securityPage.ownSpace.description: Security information is viewable from any account view, but settings can only be changed in My Account View.
securityPage.hero.description: Fin Freedom Network is built on transparent, on-chain mechanisms. Your security responsibilities are clear: you control your wallet, you verify transactions, you protect your keys.
securityPage.custody.title: Self-Custody
securityPage.network.warningText: Please switch to Polygon Mainnet for secure transactions.
securityPage.responsibility.title: Wallet Security Is Your Responsibility
securityPage.responsibility.privateKeyTe: Fin Freedom Network will never request your private key, seed phrase, or recovery phrase. Anyone asking for this information is a scammer.
securityPage.responsibility.walletFinalT: Wallet addresses cannot be changed after registration. If your wallet has been compromised, you must create a new wallet before registering.
securityPage.responsibility.irreversible: Once confirmed on the blockchain, transactions cannot be reversed or refunded. Always verify transaction details before signing.
securityPage.responsibility.verifyText: Check the wallet prompt, recipient address, and amount before confirming any transaction. Fin Freedom Network cannot recover funds sent to incorrect addresses.
securityPage.transparency.title: Built on Verifiable Code
securityPage.transparency.smartContracts: All core mechanisms are enforced by immutable smart contracts on public blockchains.
securityPage.transparency.noAdminTitle: No admin access to user funds
securityPage.transparency.noAdminText: No single individual has unilateral authority over user funds. Multisig governance controls protocol parameters.
securityPage.transparency.payoutRulesTex: Every reward follows a clear, predefined structure that cannot be altered arbitrarily.
securityPage.transparency.auditsText: Smart contracts will undergo independent security audits.
securityPage.risks.title: Participation Involves Risks
securityPage.risks.smartContractText: Smart contracts may contain coding errors or unforeseen behavior despite audits.
securityPage.risks.tokenVolatilityText: Tokens may fluctuate in value, experience low liquidity, or lose value entirely.
securityPage.risks.phishingText: Only use official channels. Never share your private key or send funds to unknown addresses.
securityPage.risks.userErrorText: Sending funds to incorrect addresses or interacting with malicious contracts can result in permanent loss.
securityPage.risks.regulatoryText: Cryptocurrency regulations vary by jurisdiction and may change at any time.
securityPage.risks.disclaimer: Participation in Fin Freedom Network involves significant risks. You should only participate if you fully understand and willingly accept these risks. No guarantees are made regarding profits, income, or returns.
securityPage.bestPractices.title: Recommended Safety Habits
securityPage.bestPractices.officialLinks: Always verify you are on the official Fin Freedom Network website and using trusted support channels.
securityPage.bestPractices.reviewTransac: Check recipient addresses, amounts, and contract interactions before signing.
securityPage.bestPractices.storeKeysText: Never store your seed phrase digitally. Use hardware wallets or secure offline storage.
securityPage.bestPractices.stayInformedT: Follow official announcements for updates about platform security and new features.
securityPage.support.title: Official Support Channels
securityPage.support.text: Fin Freedom Network will never contact you first via DM or request your private key. Always use official support channels listed in the Community Hub.
securityPage.support.reportSuspicious: Report suspicious activity through the official support ticket system.
securityPage.bestPractices.verifyNetwork: Always confirm you're on the correct blockchain network before approving transactions.
